description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1805/32 of 10.04.2013 - Cad. Map No. 520202 and Other Amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, servitude rights, and land extents for various properties in the Colombo District. It contains detailed land registration information including cadastral maps, block numbers, parcel numbers, and specific land measurements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
